systems_changed.change_summary: Haunt base bounty and growth +10%, but Haunt HP and damage +10%. Camps pay more at every stage of the game and hit back harder, so clear speed and sustain become the real gate on jungle income.
driving_changes: Haunts base bounty and growth increased by 10%
Haunts HP and Damage output increased by 10%
systems_changed.effect_on_play: AoE/sustain clearers bank faster and chain camps without backing; slow or single-target clearers lose HP per camp and start skipping camps, and the gap between the two widens every minute. Jungle income is now a clear-quality test, not a routing test.

systems_changed.change_summary: Comeback gold from non-hero sources caps at 30% (was 26%), and the behind-multiplier now also boosts tick souls for the two poorest players. The trailing team gets paid continuously off farm, not only on kills.
driving_changes: Comeback gold from non-hero sources increased from a max of 26% to 30% (when behind by ~20% Net Worth)
The bonus NPC souls multiplier when behind now also increases tick souls for the 2 poorest players
systems_changed.effect_on_play: A losing econ now compounds instead of stagnating, so the KB's 'leads stick' premise is reversed. A team that is ahead must convert into Guardians/Walkers fast, because the losing team's item floor keeps rising while they farm.

systems_changed.change_summary: Secure rate is 25% slower at baseline but up to 50% faster scaled to net-worth deficit, maxing at a 20% gap. Contested farm souls favor the team that is behind and are harder for the leader to lock down.
driving_changes: Haunted Souls secure rate is now 25% slower
Haunted Souls secure rate is now up to 50% faster than baseline based on how far behind you are in Net Worth compared to the enemy team's average (max rate at a 20% Net Worth gap)
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Camp contests turn into a lever for the losing side: a diver who is behind can steal the Haunt soul the leader is channelling. Leaders must kill and secure in one clean pass rather than drag out camp fights.

systems_changed.change_summary: Breakable growth values cut 10% and the box-respawn stall bug fixed. Crates stay the guaranteed-souls floor but no longer scale into the mid game.
driving_changes: Fixed some boxes taking longer to respawn if another box's or powerup's pickup was left on the ground
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Heavy-melee crate routing is a lane-phase income tool now, not a 20-minute side stream; crate openers must graduate to Haunt camps or fights to keep pace.

systems_changed.change_summary: New Heavy-Melee-breakable cauldrons drop Candy stashed in the player's pocket, consumed later for a temporary Sugar Rush buff. Event runs through Nov 2, so it is a timed layer on the map, not a permanent one.
driving_changes: With a Heavy Melee, break the cauldron to pick up a piece of Candy and stash it in your pocket for later
you can consume the candy to grant yourself a boost of energy with the temporary Sugar Rush buff
The Halloween festivities are available in-game now through November 2nd, 2026.
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Heavy Melee gains a second detour reason alongside crates, and fights can be pre-loaded with a stored buff instead of bought from a shop. Sugar Rush's exact stats are unclear from the notes; treat it as a tempo consumable, not a build item.

systems_changed.change_summary: Steam Vents now grant +150% stamina regeneration, reworking the stealth-roam role the KB had priced in. Vents become a stamina battery rather than a free approach.
driving_changes: Steam Vents now increase stamina regeneration by 150%
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Vent play converts from invisibility ganks into extra dashes mid-fight or mid-rotation, which helps stamina-hungry divers and tanks more than it helps gankers; the KB's 'vent gank' discipline test loses its main driver.

systems_changed.change_summary: Move-slow-to-air-drag ratio 0.35 -> 0.5, so slows bite harder on airborne movement.
driving_changes: Move slow to air drag ratio increased from 0.35 to 0.5
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Flyers and airborne escapes bleed more speed under a slow, so slow application gets stronger and grounded kiting harder to escape. This deepens the flyer tax; heroes that live in the air need a slow cleanse or a different exit.

systems_changed.change_summary: Tunnel move speed +70% -> +50%. The fastest corridor rotation on the map is slower.
driving_changes: Move speed in tunnels reduced from +70% to +50%
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Flank and respawn-to-hub timings lengthen by a beat; teams already staged at Bell Tower/Sunken Plaza get a small edge over teams rotating through tunnels.

systems_changed.change_summary: The latest six heroes lose the 'new' flag: normal unlock requirements in ranked, and they can now be banned.
driving_changes: Latest 6 heroes are no longer categorized as "new" anymore. This means they have normal hero unlocking requirements for ranked and can now be banned.
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Their pick rates get capped by bans and their win rates regress toward the field; the vote-gated six stop being a free pick and enter normal draft counterplay, which disproportionately hits whichever of the six the snapshot shows as overtuned.

tempo_shift.why: Three coordinated comeback levers (30% non-hero comeback cap, tick souls to the two poorest, 25%-to-50% faster secure when behind) attack the lead-holding pattern the KB called out, and Haunt bounty/growth +10% gives the trailing team a compounding farm floor toward the ~30-min Broker. The opposing pull (Haunts hit +10% harder, faster clearers snowball harder) is real but narrower in scope.

archetype_effects.why: Haunt damage +10% and Healing Snacks 10%->14% max HP pay regen and HP stacking, and Heavy Melee now opens both crates and candy cauldrons.
Haunt bounty and growth +10% is pure profit for AoE camp clearers, who dodge most of the Haunt HP +10% cost because they one-cycle the camp.
30% non-hero comeback gold plus tick souls to the two poorest gives a trailing scaler a guaranteed item floor to reach the ~30-min Broker, which the KB called the only real late spike.
Breakables growth -10% trims the guaranteed crate souls that converted early lane pressure, while the lane itself is untouched and Haunt income rose relative to it.

Steam Vents trade stealth approach for +150% stamina regen (more dashes in-fight) while tunnels drop +70%->+50% and the air-drag ratio 0.35->0.5 taxes airborne exits — gankers gain fight mobility, lose the free angle.
Breakables growth -10% and slower tunnel rotations both cut the side-lane payout and rotation speed that split pushing was converting into income.

intent_read: Valve is removing the structural reason leads were unbreakable: instead of a kill-bounty comeback, the comeback valve now sits inside farm itself (secure rate for the trailing side, tick souls to the two poorest, 30% non-hero comeback gold). At the same time, Haunt HP/damage +10% keeps the off-lane map the skill test — income still comes from the jungle, but the jungle now actively redistributes it toward the team that is behind.
